text:
This is an honest review. I went in because of a toothache, but I didn't know what it was, so I asked for an examination first. It turned out I had a wisdom tooth that had penetrated my molar, reaching the nerve. So I needed to either have the tooth extracted or get a dental implant.
But I didn't have that much money, so I chose to have two teeth extracted.
It cost me 3500 baht.
I think the price was very worthwhile.
Because 1) I had an examination, 2) an X-ray, and 3) I had two teeth extracted, one of which was embedded in the gum, only slightly protruding.
If I went to a government clinic (I checked the waiting list), I would have to wait another two months, which is a very long time.
So I chose this clinic. After the extraction, I received medication and ice packs. Overall, I was very satisfied. The service was excellent, and the doctor explained everything well.

For those wondering if tooth extraction hurts:
The doctor injects local anesthetic. It's not painful, but there's a slight tingling sensation because it's like a nerve is being hit. But the doctor did a good job.

I highly recommend this clinic for anyone considering treatment.
